text:
mina: heads-up: eu-central had a ~40% bump in spot terminations around 02:40. thinking about a small hedging layer that proactively migrates at-risk in-flight work instead of waiting for term. quick reactions?
raj: sounds useful. main question is "when". we should use an expected-value test: migrate iff preempt_prob * expected_redo_cost > migration_cost. expected_redo_cost = remaining_tokens * token_cost + latency_penalty.
olivia: agree. also want a 2-tier migration: (1) warm-transfer (transfer KV cache + resume on prewarmed worker), (2) full reserved slot if no warm available. warm-transfer is much cheaper.
sam: operator model: control-plane emits Recommendation objects, operator re-checks admission (tenant burst credits, global cap) and executes. operator must be idempotent and keep a per-request cooldown (e.g., 5m) to avoid flapping.
mina: example rec proto (pseudo):
```
{ "req_id": "r-abc123", "recommend": "migrate", "score": "0.78", "ttl_s": "45", "reason": "high_preempt_prob, eta~180s" }
```
raj: TTL + rec_version are critical so operator doesn't act on stale recs. also track why to help debugging.
olivia: observability: migrations_triggered, migrations_rejected_admission, migration_success_rate, post_migrate_p95_latency, reserved_cost_delta_by_tenant. traces must link original->migrated spans.
sam: rollout/circuit-breaker: start with internal tenants behind feature_flag=eviction_hedge_alpha, canary 5% burst-eligible tenants, auto-disable if weekly reserved_spend_delta > 3% OR migration_success_rate < 92% over 48h.
mina: testing: build a sim harness that replays traces, injects term events (poisson/bernoulli), models warm pool sizes and costs; use to tune thresholds.
raj: billing: tag migrated work with migrated=true and tenant_migration_tag so billing team can reconcile. include reconciliation job for double-charge detection.
olivia: policy detail: prefer warm-transfer when remaining_eta < warm_resume_overhead_threshold (e.g., < 300s). for very long requests consider immediate full reserved migration.
sam: admission controls: per-tenant migration_rate_limit, global_max_migrations_per_minute, and a reserved_headroom_check. operator should decrement a migration token when it starts to avoid bursts.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: planned rollout -> feature_flag=eviction_hedge_alpha target=staging 20%
mina: i'll draft an RFC with decision function, proto, sim plan, rollout checklist, and ownership. will ping runtime+infra+billing for reviews.
raj: ok. i'll add simple expected-value notebook to RFC with knobs for token_cost and latency_penalty.
olivia: i'll draft warm-transfer notes (KV snapshot format, resume handshake).
sam: thanks. conservative defaults early; we can relax after sim + staging metrics. :thumbsup:
